name: 13228-guidedregex-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 160 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (40 warmup, 120 measured).
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens (min = max = 128). Every request carries the same regex at `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.regex` -- 40 repeats of a fixed log line, a conforming document of 1174-1280 tokens on this tokenizer -- and `output_tokens: 1408` is a CAP above that worst case, so the constraint terminates the request first. `ignore_eos: false` and `temperature: 0.0`. `request_format: plain` is required: the default asks this engine generation's tokenizer wrapper for a chat template it does not have, which errors every request and reports 0.0 on every metric rather than failing.
purpose: A log-formatting assistant turning short prompts into long regex-constrained records for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
